# Rigshospitalet Kirurgisk Gastroenterologi

Rigshospitalet Kirurgisk Gastroenterologi (Surgical Gastroenterology at Rigshospitalet) is a surgical department within Denmark's national hospital system that treats patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) and related surgical conditions. The department's surgical quality is measured using re-operation rates, which track the proportion of patients requiring surgery again within 30 days of their initial surgical procedure—a standard indicator of surgical safety and technique [^src1].

As of the 2024 assessment period, Rigshospitalet Kirurgisk Gastroenterologi reported a re-operation rate of 12%, significantly above the development target of 8% [^src1]. This metric is one of several quality indicators monitored by DANIBD, the Danish national clinical database for inflammatory bowel disease, which publishes annual performance data to support continuous improvement across all Danish IBD treatment centers [^src1]. The elevated re-operation rate signals an area where the department's surgical outcomes may warrant clinical review and process improvement.
